Scope and remaining work Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS: Statistical checks apply to fixed seeds and budgets. ESS concerns the mean only; Rhat is not rank-normalized. No guarantee covers multimodality, high dimensions, every seed, mixing or a specified false-positive rate. Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations. Independent MCMC diagnostic checks: rank Rhat, bulk/tail ESS and degeneracies: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations. ArviZ raw constant-ESS=N is not evidence of mixing. Globally identical values yield null/status; differing per-chain constants yield null/infinite-separation Rhat while retaining raw huge-finite/infinite library values outside ordinary finite comparisons. Bulk ESS is not a raw-mean MCSE estimator.
